text: Cute floating island with a little garden bed of red tomatoes(?) and a white bunny. Hint says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, a 30-sec timer, 10 coins, Lv1. Tapping the crop bed.
Whole day cycle in 30 sec - sun, sunset, night with moon. Pretty. Sowed and watered, plants growing fast. Now it says 'Tap a Momo' - the bunny must be a Momo. Tapping it.

Assigned the Momo to the farm tile, it's now 'Working at Farm'. A text box explains empty tiles can build farm, mine, lumberyard or lab. Lots of text at once, but OK. Island is 2x2 tiles it seems. Tapping Got it.
Momo is now farming on its own, coins ticking up (26, +16/min). Mailbox has a red dot and the momo has an envelope bubble. Opening the Mailbox.
Lovely letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Charming touch. Tapping 'Let's research it'.
Research tree with tabs Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + $20 and says 'Build a research lab'. So I need a lab for flasks. Trying that button.
Tapped an empty tile: build menu. Farm $10, Mine Lv3, Lumberyard and Research lab Lv2, Special 0/1. I'm Lv1 65/90 so lab soon. Building a second farm for $10.
Level 2 now. Second letter proposes Watering efficiency. A hint says I can buy sea tiles next to the island for $25 - expanding the island, nice. Queue research then Got it.
Lv2 unlocked lab ($40) and lumberyard ($80). I have 96. Building a Research lab so the research proposals can start.
Lab is built, and my Momo seems to be standing at the lab now. A flask counter '1' appeared under the day. Hire panel: Hire Momo $60. I have 68 - hiring a second Momo so one farms and one researches.
Mochi (new hire) is now working at the Research lab. Flask counter is 2. Field expansion needs 3. Going to the Research panel to see if I can start it.
Started Field expansion research (19s). Hit Lv3 - next level needs 430 XP, big jump. Mine should be unlocked now. Checking mailbox, then thinking about buying the sea plot.

Field expansion finished (Crops +1). New letter suggests Bigger harvests. These letters are a nice way to guide research - feels like the bunnies have ideas. Queueing it, then going to Research to start Watering efficiency or Bigger harvests.
Watering efficiency researching (1m30s, cost $40 + flasks). Income +108/min. Now I want to fill the last empty tile at the front of the island. Lv3 - maybe a Mine.
Mine costs $120 + 10 Wood (shown in red - I have no wood). So the order is Lumberyard first ($80) to get wood. Building a Lumberyard on the last tile.

Lumberyard built (cute stump with axe). Hire price rose to $100, I have 92. One bunny seems to be standing on the lumberyard tile - not sure if it's working there or just walking. Waiting a few seconds for money.
Hired Pomu (third bunny). Wood is now 4 even before assigning anyone, so free-time bunnies seem to help out. This time I'll try the big 'Assign' button instead of the pencil to see the difference.

Tapped the lumberyard: 'Another Momo works here'. Huh - I never assigned anyone there; maybe a bunny assigned itself, or one Momo per building. A bit unclear who is where. I'll put Pomu on the left farm instead.

Oops, my tap on the farm selected the Momo standing there instead of assigning Pomu. Now I see numbers 1,2,3 on tiles - maybe Momo's route order? Not sure if Pomu got assigned. Let me check Status for an overview.

Status screen gives me a real goal: grow Village into a City. Need Land 4/9, Momo 3/3 (done), Research levels 2/3, Value produced 516/1.5K. Clear checklist - I like that. So buying sea plots is the main next step. I have $176.
Bought a sea plot - the island grew with a new grass tile and a bush. Satisfying! Next plot $35. Buying that too (have 213).
Island now has 6 tiles, an L-shape. Research has a red dot - probably watering done. Want a 3rd research level for the City goal.
Started Bigger harvests (2 min, $60). Now Lv4 - next level needs 1200 XP! Have 12 wood and ~200 coins, so going to build a Mine on one of the new tiles.
Mine is being built on the new bottom tile (7 sec). Mailbox has a new letter again. Reading it.
Mine works now (1/1), a bunny wandered over to it by itself. Dig bar filling. Income dropped a bit (170 -> 146/min), maybe a farmer moved to the mine. Checking Hire price for a 4th bunny.
Got my first stone. But income keeps dropping (now 130/min) and both farms look ripe with nobody harvesting - all bunnies are crowded around lumberyard/mine. Hiring a 4th for $155 to fix the farms.
Left farm says 'Another Momo works here' - looks like each building takes only one bunny. Hard to tell which buildings are free without tapping each. Trying the top farm for Mugi.
Hmm, instead of assigning Mugi, the tap opened the top farm itself (Farm 0/1, empty, Sow button). Not sure if Mugi got assigned. Sowing by hand meanwhile.
Sowed and watered the top farm by hand, bunnies showing hearts. The next sea plot is hidden behind the bottom buttons; trying to drag the view up to reach it.
Dragging didn't move the camera. Bigger harvests research finished - that should make Research levels 3/3 for the City goal. Harvesting the top farm by hand.

City checklist now: Momo 4/3 done, Research 3/3 done, Land 6/9, Value 972/1.5K. Need 3 more land plots. Income dropped to 118/min - top farm sits idle, 0/1 worker. With a few more minutes I'd buy land and become a City. Fun loop.
Bought a 7th land plot for $45 by tapping the water plot. Land 7/9 now. The next plot is slipping off the bottom of the screen. Almost out of time - I'd keep going for the City upgrade.
Bought plot 8 for $55 (should be Land 8/9). One more plot and some more value and I could become a City. Wish I had a couple more minutes.
